binding_model_id.help: Setting a value makes this action available in the sidebar for the given model.

state.help:
Type of server action. The following values are available:
- 'Update a Record': update the values of a record
- 'Create Activity': create an activity (Discuss)
- 'Send Email': post a message, a note or send an email (Discuss)
- 'Send SMS': send SMS, log them on documents (SMS)- 'Add/Remove Followers': add or remove followers to a record (Discuss)
- 'Create Record': create a new record with new values
- 'Execute Code': a block of Python code that will be executed
- 'Send Webhook Notification': send a POST request to an external system, also known as a Webhook
- 'Multi Actions': define an action that triggers several other server actions

sequence.help: When dealing with multiple actions, the execution order is based on the sequence. Low number means high priority.

model_id.help: Model on which the server action runs.

code.help: Write Python code that the action will execute. Some variables are available for use; help about python expression is given in the help tab.

child_ids.help: Child server actions that will be executed. Note that the last return returned action value will be used as global return value.

crud_model_id.help: Specify which kind of record should be created. Set this field only to specify a different model than the base model.

link_field_id.help: Specify a field used to link the newly created record on the record used by the server action.

group_ids.help: Groups that can execute the server action. Leave empty to allow everybody.

update_path.help: Path to the field to update, e.g. 'partner_id.name'

value.help:
For Python expressions, this field may hold a Python expression that can use the same values as for the code field on the server action,e.g. `env.user.name` to set the current user's name as the value or `record.id` to set the ID of the record on which the action is run.

For Static values, the value will be used directly without evaluation, e.g.`42` or `My custom name` or the selected record.

webhook_url.help: URL to send the POST request to.

webhook_field_ids.help: Fields to send in the POST request. The id and model of the record are always sent as '_id' and '_model'. The name of the action that triggered the webhook is always sent as '_name'.

followers_type.help:
- Specific Followers: select specific contacts to add/remove from record's followers.
            - Dynamic Followers: all contacts of the chosen record's field will be added/removed from followers.

activity_user_type.help: Use 'Specific User' to always assign the same user on the next activity. Use 'Dynamic User' to specify the field name of the user to choose on the record.

website_url.help: The full URL to access the server action through the website.

website_published.help: A code server action can be executed from the website, using a dedicated controller. The address is <base>/website/action/<website_path>. Set this field as True to allow users to run this action. If it is set to False the action cannot be run through the website.
